text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking around the campus, I hear boisterous hollering from the rooftops.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I WANT TO EAT MORE CARROT ICE CREEAAAM!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I AM ACTIVELY RECRUITING HEROES! LET'S TEAM UP AND BEAT THE BAD GUUUYS!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: PREEEEEEZ! PAY MORE ATTENTION TO MEEE!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Your feelings are conveyed loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay, is there anyone else? Shout from the rooftop to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Could the cause of the disturbance be…
choice_data_list: Bakushin O?! What on earth are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking around, I notice that the shouting has drawn a large crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to do something about this before it devolves into a bigger mess, so I start running for the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Why are you so out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks for listening!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm also here to listen to and accept the passionate feelings of the other students!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: We all have emotions that we keep bottled up, hidden from anyone here in the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But! Sometimes you just feel like sharing and letting everyone know how you feel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's when I realized it! It feels good to yell what you want in a place that attracts a lot of attention!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And when I listen to everyone's shouts of release, it helps me channel my full power as a model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I once let out a shout while cleaning on the roof, and it felt incredibly invigorating.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I realized that yelling your lungs out somewhere high up feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So that's what it was. I understand why you did it, but it's not good to do something like that without getting permission.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Members of the Student Council! Have you all come to laud me for my outstanding service?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Nonsense! As if that's why we'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your actions cause nothing but a disturbance. Understood? Hurry and clear off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I-I object! Listening to what students have to say isn't causing anyone trouble!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is the class representative's duty to heed the call when necessary! I'm not leaving until I've heard everyone out!
choice_data_list: How about getting permission right here and now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nudge her back to try and get her to leave, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I. SHAN'T. BUDGE.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I can't leave until I've fulfilled my duty as class representative and heard everyone out!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I suppose there's nothing wrong with hearing what our students have to say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you're talking about a suggestion box, we already have one. I believe it to be an adequate form of communication.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's nowhere near adequate! There are feelings that can only be conveyed face-to-face!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Face-to-face? Certainly, there's logic in your words… Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can't permit this kind of gathering, but I do want you to listen to what the students have to say from now on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I myself also intend to listen more closely to the student body as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wowie! What an honor! To think I'd be praised by the student council president like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As expected of a model student! Verily, I am an Umamusume born to be class representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having to dissolve the gathering, Sakura Bakushin O is burning with enthusiasm after receiving a personal request from the student council president.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest that acting without permission may not have been wise, but if she gets permission then there'll be less issues in the future.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, well, I'm off to the director's office then! Full speed ahead, GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O takes off in a flurry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sorry for keeping you all waiting! I got permission from the director!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I believe her exact words were, "Approved! Sounds like fun!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: She'll be picking the date and time and emphasized that I'm to avoid causing trouble for those around us, though…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Understood. You have my approval. There is no problem, provided you adhere to the rules.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's not a bad idea. It might prove a good opportunity for us to participate too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Whatever your feelings entail, I'll accept them head-on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If there's anything bothering the students, I'll do my best to help find a solution!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Just don't cause any major commotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's proposal is accepted with open arms. It seems that students with various things on their minds have started to visit the rooftop from time to time.
